verdict.rationale: Factory docs mention creating a Markdown file for personal/project/shared 'output styles' (factory-docs-43), which could serve as a lightweight convention file, but this is framed around output formatting/tone rather than a dedicated codebase-conventions context file that shapes plans and code generation. There's no explicit AGENTS.md-like mechanism or documentation describing how such a file informs planning/code quality. missing for 10: a dedicated repo-conventions context file (e.g. AGENTS.md-equivalent), explicit doc on how it influences plan/code generation, independent confirmation of effect on agent behavior.
